_read_me: The One-Person OS safety gate config. mode is ask (Claude must get your click first) or block (Claude can never do it, you do it yourself). each rule: name, why, tools (which tools it watches, a regex on the tool name), patterns (regexes, case-insensitive), enabled (true or false). a broken file blocks every action until fixed. that is on purpose.

rules.name: git-push
rules.why: pushing code to a remote can publish it or trigger a live deploy

rules.name: git-push-connector
rules.why: a connector that pushes files or merges code changes the live copy

rules.name: deploy
rules.why: deploys and package publishes change what the public sees

rules.name: deploy-connector
rules.why: a connector that deploys or publishes a site changes what the public sees

rules.name: public-post
rules.why: posting to social media or a public channel cannot be taken back

rules.name: public-post-connector
rules.why: a connector that posts or publishes puts words in public under your name

rules.name: send-message
rules.why: emails, texts and DMs go out under your name and cannot be unsent

rules.name: send-message-connector
rules.why: a connector that sends, replies or forwards speaks for you

rules.name: payments
rules.why: anything that charges, pays, refunds or buys moves real money

rules.name: payments-connector
rules.why: a connector that charges, buys or transfers moves real money

rules.name: delete-files
rules.why: deleting files can lose work for good

rules.name: delete-connector
rules.why: a connector that deletes or trashes can lose data for good

rules.name: protect-the-gate
rules.why: Claude must not edit the safety gate or its settings, only you do

rules.name: browser-actions
rules.why: a browser click can post, buy or send. off by default because it asks on every click
